prompts.design_rationale: Exact original minimal prompt; two independent stochastic references.

Recurring interpretation, arithmetic and feasibility weaknesses occur across the development set; broad candidate checklists also lose previously correct tasks, motivating a concise general procedure.

Repeated standard-form, substitution-order, coefficient, real-domain and feasible-branch instructions are visible in the reviewed gradients; broad algebraic losses caution against forcing this procedure on other problems.

The reviewed failures repeatedly concern distinguishability, forbidden combinations, threshold events, replacement and joint selection processes; this procedure addresses model choice and exhaustive coverage.

Recurrent geometry traces concern region identification, unproved scaling, tangency constraints, determinant signs and inverse vertex transformations; direct modeling is more specific than generic checking.
Reviewed failures repeatedly concern structured integer arithmetic, distinct-prime counting, noninvertible modular division, simultaneous residues, digit-case completeness and base conversion.
